verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs claim energy efficiency and 'exceptional battery life' for M4 Max, but there is no documented power envelope (TDP/wattage) and no independent sustained-performance-per-watt or throttling testing in the evidence — community comments focus on raw benchmark scores, not power efficiency or throttling behavior. missing for 10: documented wattage/power envelope specs, independent thermal/sustained-render testing, performance-per-watt comparisons.
